title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The bundled standard library index catches up with the parser
summary: The Kotlin standard library index shipped inside the extension had stayed on the reading the parser had 120 releases ago. 238 of its 326 files disagreed with it.

highlights.title: 210 standard library declarations come back
highlights.description: Enum.name, Enum.ordinal, Enum.compareTo and the companion objects of Boolean, Char and the primitive types were absent from the shipped index, so Go to Definition and the Outline could not reach them.

highlights.title: A type argument is no longer read as a parent
highlights.description: 206 parent lists were wrong in that index: List had E for a parent next to Collection, and Boolean was its own parent. Type Hierarchy showed both.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Rebuilds the bundled standard library index, frozen since version 1.22.0.
A test reparses every source the index carries and compares it to what the index stores, so the artifact can no longer drift behind the parser in silence.
